description:
List all brains accessible to the authenticated user. Returns each brain's id, name, description, aliases, status, note count, last compiled timestamp, and visibility. Match description and aliases to resolve natural-language references (e.g. "restaurant brain"). Brains are site-agnostic — no domain or site_id needed.

Cross-brain retrieval: returns every brain in the account, so an answer about one can draw on another — say so when it does. Private brains are omitted here but stay readable via get_brain by name.
name: list_brains
title: List Brains
